title: SRD frog/toad/behir-style 'exiting prone' on corpse escape reads as mention for prone (leaf-level)
description: Found under eshyra-53fm.1: giant-frog and giant-toad leaves with only 'escape from the corpse ... exiting prone' classify prone as mention while sibling creatures (behir, kraken, etc.) read applies via other sentences. Decide whether 'exiting prone' is an infliction. Not a removal.
notes: Captain 2026-11-07: fixed inline (closed form 'exiting <condition>'; frog/toad prone mention -> applies, consistent with the 5 other swallowers). In PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/735. Stays in_progress until merged.
